error_reasons.action: Re-learn the chapter from notes, solve all PYQs again. Fix ✅ chapters first.

error_reasons.meaning: Knew it, slipped (units, sign, misread NOT)
error_reasons.action: Write exact slip on sticky note, review before next mock.

error_reasons.meaning: Ran out of time / spent >5 min
error_reasons.action: Any question past 5 minutes should have been marked and left.
Answer only when two options are ruled out. Keep MCQ negatives below 3 marks.

question_types.name: Multiple Choice Questions
question_types.rules: +1 or +2 marks, -0.33 or -0.66 negative mark. Rule out 2 options before guessing.

question_types.name: Multiple Select Questions
question_types.rules: No negative marks, no partial marks. Judge each option independently like 4 True/False statements.

question_types.name: Numerical Answer Type
question_types.rules: No negative marks. Keep precision while working, round once at the end. Verify units (ms vs μs, bits vs bytes).
